It is a whole line and a whole sentence, Tell’s, spoken to Hedwig in the opening of Act III, scene 1; it renders Früh übt sich, was ein Meister werden will, a standard winged word in German, which is the fame signal. Though the German has become proverbial, it originates in this named work, so it is not an anonymous proverb and is in scope. 1847 for the Bohn first printing is consistent with the preface date of November 1846.
